title: Assessment of Security Risk Faced by Singaporean Individuals, Firms or Media Organisations
what_it_is: Assessment of Security Risk Faced by Singaporean Individuals, Firms or Media Organisations

sections.label: Pushing foreign agenda to subvert
sections.summary: The position is clear when a foreign country's or party's agenda is pushed to subvert one's own country.

sentences.speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
sentences.text: First, on Ms Anthea Ong's questions, say, you push a foreign country's or a specific party's agenda to subvert your own country, the position is clear.

sections.label: No published foreign influence lists
sections.summary: No general lists have been published about organisations and individuals who may potentially be subject to foreign influence.

sentences.speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
sentences.text: On the second part of Ms Anthea Ong's question, as the Nominated Member knows, no such general lists have been published about organisations and individuals who may potentially be subject to foreign influence.

sections.label: Foreign influences Singapore seeks to avoid
sections.summary: Not all foreign influences are avoided; those that disrupt society, weaken the country or affect foreign policy are dealt with.

sentences.speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
sentences.text: It is not all foreign influences that we seek to avoid.

sentences.speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
sentences.text: We seek to deal with, for example, foreign influences that seek to disrupt our society, weaken our country, affect our foreign policy.

sections.label: Aw's HK$6 million loans
sections.summary: Aw was given loans totalling HK$6 million with very friendly interest rates and repayment terms.

sentences.speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
sentences.text: Aw was given loans totalling HK$6 million with very friendly interest rates and repayment terms.

sections.label: Eastern Sun's non-journalistic functions
sections.summary: The Eastern Sun undertook non-journalistic functions at the direction of the PRC government, and officials Aw approached were undercover intelligence agents.

sentences.speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
sentences.text: The Eastern Sun was also known to undertake non-journalistic functions at the direction of the People's Republic of China government, such as de facto diplomatic representation, support and cover for People's Republic of China intelligence officials, and the senior officials whom Aw approached were, in fact, undercover intelligence agents of communist China.

sections.label: American intelligence foreign influence operation
sections.summary: Intelligence agencies concluded American intelligence had a significant role in operations that were a foreign influence operation with stated motives.

sentences.speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
sentences.text: Our intelligence agencies concluded that American intelligence had a significant role in these operations and that this was a foreign influence operation and the motive was to create a weapon that would shape public opinion as a pressure point and also to create an outlet that would be anti-communist against the Soviets and against communist activities in this region.

sections.label: Foreign diplomat engaging Singaporeans politically
sections.summary: A foreign diplomat encouraging Singaporeans to form a political party crosses beyond what diplomats are entitled to do, and politics should be for Singaporeans.

sentences.speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
sentences.text: And, of course, the Nominated Member of Parliament would be aware of the Hendrickson affair.

sentences.speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
sentences.text: But when a foreign diplomat engages Singaporeans and encourages them to form a political party and run, that crosses well beyond what diplomats are entitled to do.

sentences.speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
sentences.text: If you look at the Political Donations Act, that sets out the restrictions.

sentences.speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
sentences.text: If you look at the Newspaper and Printing Presses Act (NPPA), that sets out a number of restrictions and I can name you other legislation.

sentences.speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
sentences.text: But the key point is politics, and Singapore should be for Singaporeans.

sections.label: Request for list of influenced individuals
sections.summary: The speaker was concerned that certain Singaporean individuals were mentioned repeatedly at a Conference and asked if the Minister could share a list of those under foreign influence.

sentences.speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
sentences.text: I would not suggest that of your question.

sentences.speaker: Ms Anthea Ong
sentences.text: I genuinely was concerned because, at the Conference, certain Singaporean individuals were mentioned repeatedly and I wanted to know if there was a list that the Minister could share with us, so that we are aware who these individuals are who are actually under foreign influence that have security risks.

sentences.speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
sentences.text: I think my speech was clear as to what I said.

sentences.speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
sentences.text: I will have them send a copy of my speech to the Member.
